text:
maria_csm: Flagging SigmaPulse (mid-market). They went live ~2 months ago, seats look ok but weve seen a sharp drop in report/query volume over the past 3 weeks. CSAT follow-up was 6/10: "finance reporting incomplete". I'm worried this becomes a renewal headwind.

liam_success: Thanks for flagging. Do we know which reporting flows stopped? Any support tickets?

maria_csm: Main signals: active seats unchanged, query volume down ~55% vs baseline. Problem areas called out: bulk report export, scheduled reports failing, and a few missing fields in finance exports. One open ticket (87921) re: CSV rows corrupt. No client-side feature changes recorded.

nate_onboarding: I can run a focused "export & reporting" office hours session for their admins + finance power users. Suggest 30min live + recorded walkthrough. Should we pull in product PM and eng oncall for repro?

maria_csm: Yes. Plan: 48h triage call (CS + Eng + PM), 7-day targeted enablement (office-hours + playbook), 21-day checkpoint before renew. I'll own the play; Nate handles enablement; Iris handles support; Liam monitors renewal signal.

liam_success: What's the minimal triage checklist so we can move fast?

maria_csm: Lightweight triage checklist (to be completed in first 48h):
```
- Schedule triage call with SigmaPulse stakeholders + PM + Eng oncall
- Ask customer to upload 3 sample export files and failing query IDs
- Reproduce CSV corruption in staging; attach repro to ticket
- Share temp mitigation: export script + manual field mapping guide
- Add in-app banner linking to scheduling/office-hours
- Run 30min office-hours within 7 days (record session)
- Weekly health pulse (usage metrics + quick NPS) for next 3 weeks
- If no improvement by day 21 -> escalate to AE + solutions engineering for retention options
```

iris_support: I've added private KB notes and uploaded sample CSVs to ticket 87921. Included reproduction steps and a quick python script customers can run as a stopgap. Ticket updated.

psa_bot: Ticket 87921 updated by iris_support. SLA flag set: triage requested within 48h.

nate_onboarding: I'll draft slides focused on: 1) how exports are generated, 2) runbook for scheduled reports, 3) mapping missing finance fields. Will include a short script snippet and link to the KB. Will record and drop in the case.

liam_success: For the 21-day checkpoint, what are the measurable success criteria?

maria_csm: Success criteria we can measure:
- Query/export volume >= 85% of baseline OR a documented adoption recovery plan with dates
- Open reporting-related tickets = 0 or customer has accepted mitigation
- Post-enablement NPS >= 7 OR AE formally signs off on account health

liam_success: If those aren't met, AE options? One-month credit, extended onboarding, or a custom engineering SLA?

maria_csm: AE suggested a one-month credit option and extended enablement. We'll prepare a one-page recovery plan (metrics, timeline, mitigation) for exec-level share.

nate_onboarding: Proposed owners added to calendar invite. I'll include a 15-min buffer after office-hours for the internal team to decide next steps (credit vs more enablement).

iris_support: I've attached the repro files to the ticket and linked the KB article. Also added a temporary label so Eng oncall can find it quickly.

psa_bot: Calendar event created: SigmaPulse - Reporting Triage. Event in 36 hours. Attendees: maria_csm, nate_onboarding, iris_support, product_pm, eng_oncall.

maria_csm: Posting the in-app banner copy in thread so AE can preview: "Were running a short session to improve Scheduled Reports & Exports. Join office-hours: [link]. Recorded session and export script available." ETA to push banner: 24h.

liam_success: :thumbsup: After office-hours, internal 15-min sync to decide AE offer.

maria_csm: Also capturing product feedback items for roadmap: (1) robust CSV exports, (2) scheduled report retry logic, (3) export field mappability for finance. We'll include the list in renewal notes.

nate_onboarding: Will share recording + one-pager recovery plan in this thread.

iris_support: Confirmed triage SLA noted. Will update ticket as we reproduce.

maria_csm: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make the triage call.

liam_success: :thumbsup:

nate_onboarding: :thumbsup:

iris_support: :thumbsup:

maria_csm: (follow-up) AE requested a short executive-facing summary. I'll post draft here after the triage.
